systems.name: Client Inbox Triage Bot
systems.purpose: Reads the owner's shared client inbox each morning, drafts replies with a large language model, and sends the approved drafts to clients as email from the business domain.

consequential_actions.description: Sends email to external clients from the business domain
Generates reply text with an LLM that is presented to clients as coming from the business

assumptions: Clients understand replies may be drafted with AI assistance
Sending volume stays under a few hundred messages per day
constraints: Must not send without the owner approving the draft

systems.name: Static Recipe Archive
systems.purpose: A personal, statically generated website of the owner's own recipes. Markdown files are rendered to HTML at build time and served as static files. There is no database, no user accounts, no forms, no analytics, and no server-side code.
assumptions: All recipe content is authored by the owner
No visitor information is collected or stored
constraints: No third-party scripts of any kind on the published pages
